title: Verify: phaser dependency declaration unit tests
summary: Unit tests assert package.json pins phaser to 3.90.x with no caret.
description: Add tests/phaserDependency.test.ts modelled on tests/zustandDependency.test.ts, reading only package.json from disk (no network, no npm install).
acceptance_criteria: Given package.json, when phaser is read, then it matches /^~?3\.90\.\d+$/.
Given package.json, when phaser is read, then it does not start with ^ and does not match /^\D*4\./.
technical_constraints: Read files with node:fs readFileSync like tests/zustandDependency.test.ts; no network

steps.action: Create the test file with a readJson helper (readFileSync + fileURLToPath(new URL('../package.json', import.meta.url))) and add test 'pins phaser to 3.90.x' asserting pkg.dependencies.phaser toMatch(/^~?3\.90\.\d+$/).
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserDependency.test.ts -t "pins phaser to 3.90.x"

steps.symbol: new: it('has no caret range that could resolve to 4.x')
steps.action: Add a test asserting pkg.dependencies.phaser does not start with '^' and does not match /^\D*4\./.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserDependency.test.ts
steps.expected: Both tests in the file pass.
